newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland sold 24 mln mass privatisation units.
newsitem.headline: Poland sold 24 mln mass privatisation units.

text.p: Poland sold about 1,090,000 mass privatisation units last week, bringing the total number of units sold since the start of the sale in 1995 to about 24,053,000 units, the treasury ministry said in a statement.
In the week ending November 9, 929,000 units were sold.
The National Investment Fund (NFI) units, which started trading on the Warsaw bourse in July, have been on sale since November 1995 and will be offered until Friday this week.

Under the NFI programme each of Poland's 28 million adults can buy one unit for 20 zlotys, later to be exchanged for shares in each of the 15 NFIs, grouping more than 500 firms undergoing privatisation.
The National Securities Depository (KDPW) has so far transformed 8.23 million of the certificates into paperless book-entry form, necessary for bourse trading.
